Good questions

How much are the vouchers?

We recommend a £25 voucher with a nice offer to be redeemed in January. We’ll discuss your specific offer with you when you enquire.

How do customers redeem the voucher?

We’ll send customers an email with a unique QR code on it. They simply show their code to you in the restaurant, and you can mark it as redeemed after they’ve dined with you.

How do the payments work?

Your first month is just £1. Customers pay you online for their vouchers and the money goes straight to your bank account. Our fee for your next 3 months (£199 + VAT a month) comes out of your first voucher sales as they come in. Everything after that is yours. From month 5, our fee is £199 + VAT a month, which includes £100 of Facebook and Instagram ad credit every month in your first year.

What if I don’t sell enough vouchers?

Your 3 months are covered once you’ve sold £716.40 of vouchers (£199 + VAT for each month), which is 29 vouchers at £25. If your sales come in under that, you just pay the difference.

Is there a contract?

No contract, cancel anytime.
